a.name: Zone A
a.bounds: Zone A: Auglaize, Defiance, Erie, Fulton, Hardin, Henry, Marion, Mercer, Ottawa, Paulding, Sandusky, Shelby, Van Wert, Williams and Wyandot counties, Lucas County outside zone B, and Lake Erie inside the line 100 yards offshore from the Erie–Lorain county line around Cedar Point and Cedar Point NWR toward Woodtick Peninsula (OAC 1501:31-7-07).
a.note: Ducks Oct 17 – Nov 1, Nov 14 – Dec 27. Geese Oct 17 – Nov 1, Nov 14 – Feb 1.

b.name: Zone B
b.bounds: Zone B: Allen, Ashtabula, Crawford, Cuyahoga, Geauga, Hancock, Huron, Lake, Lorain, Mahoning, Medina, Morrow, Portage, Putnam, Richland, Seneca, Summit, Trumbull and Wood counties; Lucas County south of US 24 and west of I-75; the parts of Ashland, Wayne, Holmes, Stark and Columbiana counties on the zone B side of the SR 3 – SR 60 – US 30 – SR 3 – SR 226 – SR 514 – SR 754 – SR 39 – SR 241 – US 30 – SR 39 line; and the rest of Lake Erie and its islands.
b.note: Ducks Oct 17–25, Nov 21 – Jan 10. Geese Oct 17–25, Nov 21 – Feb 15.

c.name: Zone C
c.bounds: Zone C: the rest of the state.
c.note: Ducks Oct 17–25, Dec 12 – Jan 31. Geese Oct 17–25, Nov 21 – Feb 15.

seasonsNote: Duck and goose dates differ by zone (A, B, C; new zones from 2026). September teal, the early goose season and youth / military / veterans days are statewide.

rules.d: One-half hour before sunrise to sunset (federal rule).
Required for ducks, geese, brant and coots (federal rule).
No more than 3 shells in the magazine and chamber combined.

The zone A / B line runs 100 yards offshore from the Erie–Lorain county line around Cedar Point, to the Moseley channel range rear light at Sandusky Bay, around Cedar Point NWR and toward Woodtick Peninsula. The islands and open lake are zone B.
State wildlife areas marked “restricted” on the Public land layer limit hunting (controlled hunts, permits or posted refuges); check each area before hunting.

geometryNote: Geometry: zone lines from ODNR’s official Waterfowl Zones layer (checked against OpenStreetMap: the zone B / C road line is within 60 m of the named roads everywhere, median 8 m), split against the Census TIGER outline; ODNR lands; ODNR Parks and Watercraft boating facilities; USGS NHD (water; streams from the NHD small-scale layer) and GNIS; USFWS (refuge units; NWI marsh); Census TIGER (outline, county subdivisions, borders); OpenStreetMap (roads). No tides: Lake Erie has no NOAA tide predictions.
